title: Provider Manual, Prepaid Dental HMO Plans: Member Copays for Fillings, Extractions, Root Canals and Periodontal Care
content:
Primary care dentists and referred specialists treating members of the Prepaid Dental HMO Plans collect, for the restorative, oral surgery, endodontic and periodontal procedures listed here, the member copay shown for the member's plan. Amounts are US dollars per unit stated.

## Unit of each copay

- **One-surface amalgam filling** — USD per one-surface amalgam filling.
- **One-surface anterior composite filling** — USD per one-surface anterior composite filling.
- **One-surface posterior composite filling** — USD per one-surface posterior composite filling.
- **Simple extraction** — USD per simple extraction.
- **Surgical extraction** — USD per surgical extraction of an erupted tooth.
- **Anterior root canal** — USD per anterior root canal.
- **Molar root canal** — USD per molar root canal.
- **Scaling and root planing** — USD per quadrant of scaling and root planing.
- **Periodontal maintenance** — USD per periodontal maintenance visit.

## Reading the grid

- Scaling and root planing is scheduled per quadrant, so the copay applies once for each quadrant treated. Hypothetical example: two quadrants treated for a DHMO 615 member carry two quadrant copays of 45.00 each, 90.00 in total.
- The surgical extraction copay is defined for an erupted tooth; the simple extraction copay is defined per simple extraction.
- The anterior and molar root canal copays are separate amounts; the grid states no other root canal amount.
